name: Okajima Mayuko
source:
Just like the protagonist, Mayuko is a second year university student. She is a bookworm who is rumored to be the owner of the library. Mayuko seems to have extreme androphobia due to being only educated in all girls' schools starting from elementary school. 

[Translated from [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item875?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url].]
